title: Payment Links
description: Create and share payment links with your customers

emptyState.noEcommerce: To charge online you need a connected payment processor. You can connect Stripe yourself in a few minutes, or ask support for a Blumon e-commerce affiliation.

customer.search: Search by name, email or phone
